claims.text: Agents cannot approve their own writes.

citations.quote: Northstar Labs agents may propose actions but cannot approve their own writes.

evidence.title: Agent approval and cancellation rules
evidence.text: Northstar Labs agents may propose actions but cannot approve their own writes. A person must approve the exact payload before a file write or webhook dispatch. Changing an approved payload invalidates that approval. Cancelling before dispatch blocks execution; cancelling after dispatch cannot undo an effect that has already happened. An interrupted write is marked unknown and is not automatically replayed.
